brief.zh: 从这三句已知证出：「证明器不矛盾」证不出。
brief.en: From these three givens, prove: “the prover is consistent” cannot be proved.

t.zh: 最后一步。⌜不矛盾⌝ 是一句算术的话：「没有哪句话和它的否定都证得出」。头两句已知仍是证明器自己能做的事。第一句：<level-ref to="gd-con"></level-ref>的整个推理，证明器自己也做得出（它证得出「若不矛盾，则 G 证不出」），所以证得出不矛盾，就证得出「G 证不出」。第二句：它证得出「G 证不出，则 G」（对角线），所以证得出「G 证不出」，就证得出 G。第三句是<level-ref to="gd-con"></level-ref>的结论。
t.en: The last step. ⌜consistent⌝ is a sentence of arithmetic: “no sentence is provable together with its negation”. The first two givens are again what the prover itself can do. The first: the prover can carry out the whole argument of <level-ref to="gd-con"></level-ref> (it proves “if consistent, then G cannot be proved”), so proving consistency would prove “G cannot be proved”. The second: it proves “if G cannot be proved, then G” (the diagonal), so proving “G cannot be proved” would prove G. The third is what <level-ref to="gd-con"></level-ref> proved.

after.zh: 这是第二不完备性定理，它让希尔伯特「用有限的方法证明数学不矛盾」的计划落了空。所以 Lean、Isabelle 这样的证明助手不去证自己可靠，而是把要信任的东西压到最小：一个很小的核和几条公理。
after.en: This is the second incompleteness theorem, which ended Hilbert’s programme of proving mathematics consistent by finite means. So proof assistants such as Lean and Isabelle do not prove themselves sound; they keep what must be trusted as small as can be: a little kernel and a few axioms.
